title: Request for fingerstick data entry
symptom: Users of xDrip cannot use a CGM due to warm-up, dead batteries, etc., and when entering fingerstick data, xDrip telemetry ceases to display after 24 hours, losing insulin treatment input, carb treatment, IOB, and predictive trends.
evidence_quote: Occasionally xdrip users cannot use a CGM due to warm-up, dead batteries, etc. Entering fingerstick data can maintain diabetic control (old school) until a CGM is brought back online. Bg prediction, IOB, and carb recommendations are available for 24 hours. However, subsequently all telemetry ceases to display.
